title: Server: hub role
description: Hub role of the single mimid server binary: /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory, protocol-06 endpoints, commit validation via OpenMLS PublicGroup, fanout, external-commit pending-proposal invalidation, room policy enforcement. No inter-provider auth (see decision).
design:
# Plan: mimid-1wgh.6 Server: hub role (APPROVED by Mark 2026-10-18)

## Key findings
- Policy bypass: decision .3.10 enforces only §8.1 membership + canSendMessage; a participant could rewrite roles_list or replace the app_data_dictionary via GroupContextExtensions and grant itself everything (Q2).
- The hub cannot authenticate the sender of a PrivateMessage in submitMessage; only receiver-side frank verification binds sendingUri to the MLS sender (Q9).
- No rule maps a BasicCredential identity to a participant-list user/domain; every policy check depends on it (Q1).

## Scope (v1)
Host rooms under own domain; Observer per room; endpoints /v1/update, /v1/submitMessage (+hub franking), /v1/groupInfo, /v1/reportAbuse (verify frank + log, decision .21); ordered retried /notify fanout via config peers (.17); policy in one module; external-commit vs pending-proposal handling (Q4); in-process create_room API (for .12.4); keyMaterial proxy for hosted rooms with remote targets (Q20).
Out: follower .7 (inbound notify, relay, local KeyPackages; hub defines LocalDelivery hook), JMAP .11/.12 (call in-process API), admin ban/remove .32 (needs .4.9 + external Remove), .8 OHTTP, consent endpoints, identifierQuery .5.5, SemiPrivateMessage .4.12, pseudonymous .5.12, inter-provider auth (.17, .34; From never authorizes).

## Architecture (crates/mimid-server/src)
Skeleton commit first: lib.rs, empty modules, deps (reqwest per .26; mls-rs dev-dep at .4.13 pin).
Modules: http.rs (routes, body cap, path decode .5.18, status mapping); hub/{mod,keys,room,policy,components,update,submit,group_info,abuse,key_material,fanout}.rs; peer.rs (reqwest, directory fetch/cache via mimi_protocol::Directory/UriTemplate); store/{rooms,log,outbox,keys}.rs (all SQL); migrations/0002_hub.sql (all hub tables at once in S3).
Update pipeline (commit arm): decode (cap) -> room lookup -> writer lock -> retry dedup by hash -> epoch check (wrongEpoch) -> Observer::process (stage; MLS validity only here) -> envelope check (From domain == authenticated committer's user domain) -> policy::authorize_commit (deny -> clear_pending_commit, notAllowed) -> merge -> GroupInfo rebuild/verify -> one SQL tx (log append in hub order, snapshot replace, drop old-epoch proposals, outbox rows) -> success(accepted_timestamp). Any post-merge failure -> rebuild from snapshot; nothing persisted before policy passes. MLS-valid but policy-denied commit does not consume the epoch (Q3).
Proposal arm: process, authorize (proposer as actor), store with hub_accepted_time, fan out; moreProposals forwarded verbatim (§5.5 MUST).
submitMessage: group_id/epoch header checks (older -> epochTooOld, newer -> notAllowed); envelope From vs sendingUri domain; authorize_send (participant + canSendMessage); franking when frank_aad present and franking_agent names hub key; tx log+outbox; dedup; ciphertext never parsed.
groupInfo: verify request; envelope vs credential domain; authorize_group_info (participant w/ canAddOwnClient, open join, or preauth canJoinIfPreauthorized; join codes Q13); payload GroupInfo (no tree) + RatchetTreeOption::full + pending proposals; encrypt_group_info; sign; notAuthorized/noSuchRoom.
Fanout: destinations = member domains before ∪ after commit (+origin; followers dedup); own domain via LocalDelivery; FIFO per (room, domain), head-of-line, capped exponential backoff, Retry-After, never skip; outbox in SQLite (at-least-once); From: mimi@<domain>, Host; one FanoutMessage per request (ponytail: batching).
Serialization: one tokio Mutex around the room registry = single writer (matches SQLite) (ponytail: per-room locks later, no schema change).
Storage: hub_secret (signing key + hub_key, unencrypted; Limitation; file 0600), room, room_event (seq, epoch, ts, kind, bytes, hash unique), pending_proposal, outbox, kp_ref (only if Q10b).
Restart: per room fresh in-memory mimi_mls Store + Observer::from_group_info(stored GroupInfo, tree) (sets Skip itself) + replay pending proposals; committer None after rebuild is harmless (serve stored GroupInfo). No fork change.

## Sub-beads (waves)
Wave 0: decision beads Q1-Q20 + decide .5.48; skeleton commit.
Wave 1 (parallel): M1, S3, S4 (+P1 if Q2).
Wave 2 (parallel): S5, S6, S7.
Wave 3: S8, S9 parallel, then S10. Tests per bead in tests/hub_<x>.rs; helpers tests/common/<bead>.rs.
- M1 mimi-mls hub-facing accessors: staged-commit detail (proposal kind/sender/by-ref/ProposalRef; Add identity+KeyPackageRef; Remove target), committer identity incl. external joiner, identity-change detection, processed proposal ProposalRef, full GroupInfo verify, MLSMessage group_id/epoch/authenticated_data, hub Ed25519 keygen+rand (Q16). Files observer.rs, member.rs, wire/rfc9420.rs, label.rs. Oracle mls-rs. Tests: identity change in UpdatePath reported; hostile input no panic.
- P1 (if Q2) mimi-room-policy RoleData::authorize_capability for §8.6/§8.2. Oracle Appendix A.
- S3 foundation: store split, migration 0002, keys, Hub service (lock/clock/stubs), create_room validation (external_senders==[hub] DR-6/.4.21, franking_agent per Q9, participant list contains creator, members' users listed), rebuild, http framing (MAX_BODY_LEN INVENTED, statuses Q7), log canary infra. Oracle: restart byte-identical group_context/ratchet_tree; expired-leaf mlswg GroupInfo still loads/processes after restart. Tests: secrets Debug redacted; canary at TRACE (hex/base64/Debug of keys).
- S4 policy (single authorization point, pure): authorize_commit/authorize_proposal mapping proposals to MembershipActions; commit-level rules (removed/banned users' clients all removed; added clients' users in new list; roles/preauth changes not mixed with participant changes; credential identity changes refused; GCE/ReInit/PSK per Q2; removed/banned committers only Remove/SelfRemove §5.3; check_constraints after commit .3.24); authorize_send, authorize_group_info, Occupancy impl, components.rs apply per .5.48/.3.20. Depends Q1, Q2, Q13, .5.48 (+P1). Oracle spec-derived tables, Appendix A hand-encoded. Tests: wrong identity rejected for every action/arm; banned user's commit refused; .3.50 non-enforcement documented.
- S5 update endpoint: full pipeline, dedup, pending-proposal inclusion rule (Q3), external commit vs pending (Q4), GroupInfo snapshot, fanout enqueue, Welcome destinations (Q10). Depends M1,S3,S4. Oracle mls-rs (validity) + mimi-mls Members (policy). Tests: concurrent race (exactly one success, other wrongEpoch, tree == winner's mls-rs tree); envelope mismatch refused with row counts unchanged; tampered sig no write; policy denial no outbox row; injected post-merge failure restores snapshot.
- S6 fanout: outbox worker, peer client (directory cache, headers, 201, backoff, Retry-After), LocalDelivery trait+fake, resume after restart. Depends S3. Oracle mock axum follower, bytes verbatim. Tests: order across 503->201; unknown peer parked+logged; canary no bodies at INFO.
- S7 submitMessage. Depends M1,S3,S4. Oracle mimi-mls Member PrivateMessage with frank_aad; verify via mimi-protocol verify_server_frank / Frank::verify_integrity. Tests: sendingUri not listed/banned -> notAllowed; From mismatch refused before write; epoch rules; ciphertext verbatim.
- S8 groupInfo. Depends S3,S4 (+S5 for e2e). Oracle decrypt + external join accepted at /update. Tests: non-participant w/o open join/preauth notAuthorized; credential/From domain mismatch refused.
- S9 keyMaterial proxy + reportAbuse. Depends S6, S4. Oracle mock target provider with mls-rs KeyPackages. Tests: requestingUser/credential/From mismatch refused; forged frank refused.
- S10 acceptance: create, add, send, leave via pending proposals, external join, restart mid-stream; mock follower. Oracle MLS agreement among Members; per-domain fanout streams. Test: whole-run canary.

## Questions (recommendations)
Q1 credential identity = user URI (mimi://b.example/u/bob) (a) [rec] vs client URI + mapping (b). Spec gap §3 Table 1 vs §7.5 -> decision + wg.
Q2 revise .3.10: enforce §8.6 (canChangeRoleDefinitions, canChangePreauthorizedUserList, canChangeRoomMembershipStyle, canSendMLSReinitProposal); refuse GroupContextExtensions proposals and PSK in v1; optionally §8.2 metadata.
Q3 policy-denied MLS-valid commit leaves epoch open; missing pending proposals / bad GroupInfo -> notAllowed + errorDescription.
Q4 external commits vs pending proposals: (A) refuse external commits while proposals pending [rec now] vs (B) hub regenerates/staples (needs .4.9 + external Remove) follow-up.
Q5 rebuild Observer from stored GroupInfo+tree with in-memory store [rec] vs Observer::load with file store.
Q6 single global writer lock [rec] vs per-room.
Q7 200 for decodable results, 400 undecodable, 404 unhosted, 413 oversize, 201 notify; application/octet-stream; MAX_BODY_LEN 4 MiB INVENTED; From required, consistency only.
Q8 envelope check table per endpoint; document hub cannot authenticate PrivateMessage senders.
Q9 franking mandatory: rooms carry franking_agent = hub key; submit without frank_aad -> notAllowed [rec].
Q10 Welcome routing: (a) domains of identities in Add proposals [rec, stateless, needs Q1] vs (b) record KeyPackageRefs at keyMaterial.
Q11 refuse commits whose GroupInfo embeds ratchet_tree; serve without + RatchetTreeOption::full [rec]; decision + wg.
Q12 hub always sends RatchetTreeOption::full in Welcome fanout.
Q13 join codes unsupported in v1 (joiningCode -> notAuthorized).
Q14 no groupInfo-request/external-commit correlation in v1.
Q15 create_room doesn't check room_metadata.room_uri (or reserve-then-create); coordinate .12.4.
Q16 deps: reqwest (rustls, .26), mls-rs dev-dep, keygen/rand via mimi-mls helpers [rec].
Q17 fanout destinations before ∪ after, origin included, own domain via LocalDelivery.
Q18 one Ed25519 hub key for hub_sender and franking_agent (labels separate uses).
Q19 retry outbox indefinitely with capped backoff (ponytail).
Q20 keyMaterial in .6 = proxy only; requester must be participant with canAddParticipant (§3.3 undefined) -> decision.
Extra: adding clients for an existing participant with no clients, by another user -> refuse (user joins externally §5.6 b) -> decision.

## Risks
M1 size; mls-rs lacks -10 AppDataUpdate (policy tests use mimi-mls); .5.48 blocks S4; global lock held across MLS + sqlx awaits; two SQLite stacks must share libsqlite3-sys; fanout at-least-once (.7 must dedup, 201 duplicates); Q4A can delay joins; BasicCredential + unauthenticated From + no mTLS (.16/.17) = envelope checks are consistency, not security; hub cannot withhold app messages per client during pending removal (§5.3 MUST) -> Limitation; hub secrets unencrypted (0600).
notes: 2026-10-18: removed deps on epics .3 and .5 — their remaining open children are wg/upstream/P3 items (consent landed; identifierQuery .5.5, pseudonymous .5.12, Directory move .5.40) that the hub plan does not need.
